{{Top|leg}}
An '''armorer''' was a military speciality charged with the maintenance and repair of weapons. Armorers in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] often modified weapons to suit operational needs, and were also responsible for the creation of the [[multi-weapon]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
